name: Discrete Transistor — 5V, 10V — SOT-23
description: A cluster of 5 surface-mount discrete NMOS and PMOS transistors in SOT-23 packages with 5V and 10V facets from the JLCPCB KiCad library.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an SMD discrete transistor in a SOT-23 footprint.
Choose between available NMOS (BSS123, BSS138, HL2304) and PMOS (AO3401A, BSS84) parts.
Use when matching 5V or 10V facet requirements.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or footprints other than Q_SOT-23 are required.
Parts from quality tiers other than tier B are needed.
Applications require voltage facets other than 5V or 10V.
